initialization: random; no external weights; Drone2021 only
optimizer: AdamW lr 0.001 to 0.0001 cosine; no bias/norm decay; warmup 100 updates
loss_objective: Ultralytics batch loss divided by batch size
precision: BF16 forward; FP32 loss and EMA evaluation; deterministic; TF32 off
augmentation: one native-resolution 1280x736 crop per image per epoch: images with birds are cropped to contain one randomly chosen bird at a random position, images without birds uniformly; boxes kept if >=50% of area remains; horizontal flip p=0.5; no resize, paste, mosaic or color augmentation
evaluation: original Drone validation at native resolution padded to a multiple of 32; COCO maxDets100; best by AP50-95
